mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_log ( id, principal_id, subject_id, account_id, subject_display_name, principal_display_name, module_code, action_code, result, request_uri, target_type, target_id, detail_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{entity.id}, #{entity.principalId}, #{entity.subjectId}, #{entity.accountId}, #{entity.subjectDisplayName}, #{entity.principalDisplayName}, #{entity.moduleCode}, #{entity.actionCode}, #{entity.result}, #{entity.requestUri}, #{entity.targetType}, #{entity.targetId}, CAST(#{detailJson} AS jsonb), #{entity.createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, principal_id, subject_id, account_id, subject_display_name, principal_display_name, module_code, action_code, result, request_uri, target_type, target_id, detail_json::text AS detail_json, created_at FROM sys_log WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) FROM sys_log WHERE subject_id IS NOT NULL AND subject_display_name IS NOT NULL
AND subject_display_name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
